I run Jovunara Pilates from Dhaka, Bangladesh. New Year resolutions are our opportunity to turn good intentions into trial starts, and I expect this campaign to deliver as many free-trial starts as possible. We count trial starts, not visits.

Run our X campaign from Wednesday, January 6, 2027 through Friday, January 8, 2027, inclusive: three days in the account's time zone, Dhaka time. The landing page is https://jovunarapilates.app/start. Our site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the trial starts.

Here's the exact copy from our landing page: "Made in Dhaka, Bangladesh, Jovunara Pilates is an iPhone (iOS) app with guided nine-minute Pilates routines for everyday back care. Build a New Year habit around your end-of-workday reset and start a 7-day free trial by January 10, 2027. Available worldwide except China, exclusively on iPhone (iOS)."

Everything is localized: the app and the landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

You have permission to launch and manage the campaign independently without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout the flight and make the adjustments needed to pursue trial starts. Keep the offer accurate. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Be clear about what the available reporting actually shows.

Total budget: 650.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
